title.es: Aquel en el que Don Agustín se presenta
title.en: The One Where Don Agustín Visits

description.es: Don Agustín viene a visitarlos de inmediato al enterarse del compromiso de Digna y Damián. Habla de cosas sin importancia con Marta y Digna. Debido a los últimos acontecimientos, Digna lo trata bien para tenerlo contento. Al marcharse, le sugiere a Digna que podría oficiar él la boda, y Digna se ve obligada a aceptar.
description.en: Don Agustín immediately comes to visit upon hearing of Digna and Damián's engagement. He talks pointlessly with Marta and Digna. Due to recent events, Digna treats him well to keep him happy. As he leaves, he suggests to Digna that he could officiate the wedding, and Digna is forced to accept.
